help.stdout:
Fail-closed Android cell lifecycle transaction

Usage: droidloomctl [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  install       Install a standalone APK, updating an existing app while retaining its data
  update        Update a source installation, or show pacman package-update instructions
  start         Start Droidloom, including Android, native windows, and the app catalog
  stop          Stop Droidloom and release its runtime resources
  restart       Restart the complete Droidloom runtime
  status        Report whether the cell is running
  wait          Wait for Android boot, showing progress and a deadline without restarting it
  logs          Show recent Android logs, optionally filtered by an installed app's UID
  crashes       Show the global crash buffer and recorded exits for an optional package
  launch        Launch one Android application in the boot-managed runtime
  applications  List Android applications exported to the native launcher
  dpi           Persist Android's built-in-display density, warming the runtime if needed
  window-mode   Persist how size-less initial Wayland configures are resolved
  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --socket <SOCKET>  Droidloom lifecycle socket [default: /run/droidloom/control.sock]
      --json             Emit the complete machine-readable response
  -h, --help             Print help
  -V, --version          Print version

Restart the complete Droidloom runtime

Usage: droidloomctl restart [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --no-wait          Return after restarting the services, without waiting for Android readiness
      --socket <SOCKET>  Droidloom lifecycle socket [default: /run/droidloom/control.sock]
      --mode <MODE>      Window mode; omitted preserves the current session mode
      --json             Emit the complete machine-readable response
      --spec <SPEC>      Cell specification [default: /etc/droidloom/cell.json]
  -h, --help             Print help
